description: Use this when the user asks what is around a point: the neighborhood of a lat/lon (nearest substations, the nearest transmission line, fiber, carriers and internet exchanges, flood, seismic and wildfire hazard, zoning and moratoriums, nearby data center campuses). Each block carries its source and as_of date, or states the gap (not covered here, or no answer in time). This is context, not a score: for a 0-100 build verdict on the point use analyze_site. Below full access the answer lists which blocks have an answer at the point and their sources, never their values. Ex: "What is around 39.04,-77.48?" For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

lat.description: Point latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 39.04

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

lon.description: Point longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -77.48

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

name: get_site_context
title: Get Site Context
